Card Q&A.q: Can I suspend this card itself to activate this card's [Main] effect?

Card Q&A.a: No, suspending to declare an attack is not the same as being suspended by an effect even when attacking via , so the inherited effect does not activate.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card's inherited effect activate if 1 of my Digimon attacks with  and I suspend it?

Effect: [Main][Once Per Turn] By suspending 1 of your green Digimon, you may play 1 Digimon card with [Vegetation], [Plant], or [Fairy] in one of its traits and 3000 DP or less from your hand without paying its play cost.
